```{r}
params <- list(
  res_dir = "../results",
  genome_fa = "../results/genome/GRCm39.primary_assembly.genome.fa",
  gtf = "../data/ref/gencode.vM35.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz",
  pwm_rds = "../data/ref/jaspar2024_core_vertebrates_pwm.rds",
  fdr = 0.05,
  seq_width = 200,
  n_per_bin = 3000,
  min_abs_lfc = 0.3,
  max_bin0 = 10000,
  min_score = 10,
  sig_padj = 4,
  max_heat = 60,
  target_genes = c("Ciita", "Cd40", "Cd80", "Cd86", "H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1", "H2-Eb1"),
  flank = 25000,
  n_cores = 8,
  rerun = FALSE
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(monaLisa)
  library(JASPAR2024); library(TFBSTools)
  library(Rsamtools); library(Biostrings); library(GenomicRanges); library(rtracklayer)
  library(SummarizedExperiment); library(BiocParallel); library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(dplyr); library(stringr); library(purrr)
  library(tibble); library(readr); library(patchwork)
  library(DT)
})
source("../../scripts/functions.R", local = TRUE)

bpp <- MulticoreParam(params$n_cores)
set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
# ---- Paths and inputs ----
in_rds   <- file.path(params$res_dir, "rds", "diffbind", "edger_fit_results.rds")
out_tab  <- file.path(params$res_dir, "tables", "motifs")
out_rds  <- file.path(params$res_dir, "rds",    "motifs")
out_plot <- file.path(params$res_dir, "plots",  "motifs")
walk(c(out_tab, out_rds, out_plot), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- DA results from the edgeR QL report: one table per contrast ----
edger_obj <- readRDS(in_rds)
contrasts <- names(edger_obj$res)

# ---- Genome FASTA (uncompressed or bgzipped, indexed) ----
fa <- FaFile(params$genome_fa)
if (!file.exists(paste0(params$genome_fa, ".fai"))) indexFa(fa)
keep_chr <- intersect(paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y")), seqlevels(fa))
```

```{r}
# ---- Peaks -> GRanges (optionally re-centred to a fixed width) ----
make_regions <- function(tbl, keep_chr, width = NULL) {
  gr <- GRanges(tbl$peak_id)
  mcols(gr) <- tbl |> select(any_of(c("peak_id", "logFC", "logCPM", "FDR",
                                      "gene_name", "annotation", "class")))
  gr <- gr[as.character(seqnames(gr)) %in% keep_chr]
  if (!is.null(width)) gr <- resize(gr, width = width, fix = "center")
  gr
}

# ---- Sequences named by peak_id ----
get_seqs <- function(gr, fa) {
  s <- getSeq(fa, gr)
  names(s) <- gr$peak_id
  s
}

# ---- Down-sample the unchanged bin, keeping monaLisa bin attributes ----
downsample_bin0 <- function(bins, max_n) {
  b0  <- attr(bins, "bin0")
  if (is.null(b0) || is.na(b0)) return(seq_along(bins))
  i0  <- which(as.integer(bins) == b0)
  sort(c(setdiff(seq_along(bins), i0), sample(i0, min(max_n, length(i0)))))
}

subset_bins <- function(bins, idx) {
  b_new <- bins[idx]
  for (a in setdiff(names(attributes(bins)), c("levels", "class", "names")))
    attr(b_new, a) <- attr(bins, a)
  b_new
}

# ---- Curated TF families ----
fam_patterns <- c(
  "STAT"                = "^STAT",
  "IRF"                 = "^IRF",
  "USF (Ciita pIV)"     = "^USF",
  "NF-kB"               = "^(NFKB|REL)",
  "RFX (SXY X1)"        = "^RFX",
  "CREB/ATF1 (SXY X2)"  = "^(CREB1|ATF1)$",
  "NF-Y (SXY Y)"        = "^NFY"
)

annotate_family <- function(motif_names, patterns = fam_patterns) {
  map_chr(motif_names, \(nm) {
    hit <- names(patterns)[str_detect(nm, regex(patterns, ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
  })
}

# ---- monaLisa SE -> long tibble ----
tidy_enr <- function(se) {
  long <- map(c("log2enr", "negLog10P", "negLog10Padj"), \(a) {
    assay(se, a) |>
      as_tibble(rownames = "motif_id") |>
      pivot_longer(-motif_id, names_to = "bin", values_to = a)
  }) |>
    reduce(left_join, by = c("motif_id", "bin"))

  tibble(motif_id = rownames(se), motif_name = unname(rowData(se)$motif.name)) |>
    right_join(long, by = "motif_id") |>
    mutate(family = unname(annotate_family(motif_name)))
}

# ---- Keep motifs significant in >= 1 bin ----
filter_sig_rows <- function(se, min_negLog10Padj = -log10(0.05)) {
  max_sig <- apply(assay(se, "negLog10Padj"), 1, \(x) max(x, 0, na.rm = TRUE))
  se[max_sig > min_negLog10Padj, ]
}

# ---- Report helpers: tab headers and DT tables inside loops ----
tab_header <- function(title, level = 3) {
  cat("\n\n", strrep("#", level), " ", title, " {.unlisted .unnumbered}\n\n", sep = "")
}

show_dt <- function(tbl, round_cols = NULL, signif_cols = NULL) {
  dt <- default_dt(tbl)
  round_cols  <- intersect(round_cols,  names(tbl))
  signif_cols <- intersect(signif_cols, names(tbl))
  if (length(round_cols))  dt <- formatRound(dt, columns = round_cols, digits = 3)
  if (length(signif_cols)) dt <- formatSignif(dt, columns = signif_cols)
  print(htmltools::tagList(dt))
  cat("\n\n")
}

# ---- Heatmap: top motifs clustered by PWM similarity ----
plot_top_motifs <- function(se, sig_padj, max_heat, bpp, width = 1.8, show_motif_GC = FALSE) {
  max_sig <- apply(assay(se, "negLog10Padj"), 1, \(x) max(x, 0, na.rm = TRUE))
  ids     <- names(sort(max_sig[max_sig > sig_padj], decreasing = TRUE)) |> head(max_heat)
  if (length(ids) < 2) {
    cat("Fewer than 2 motifs pass the significance cutoff.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  se_sel <- se[ids, ]
  sim    <- motifSimilarity(rowData(se_sel)$motif.pfm, BPPARAM = bpp)
  hcl    <- hclust(as.dist(1 - sim), method = "average")
  plotMotifHeatmaps(se_sel, which.plots = c("log2enr", "negLog10Padj"),
                    width = width, cluster = hcl, show_dendrogram = TRUE,
                    maxEnr = 2, maxSig = 10, show_seqlogo = TRUE,
                    width.seqlogo = 1.2, show_motif_GC = show_motif_GC)
  cat("\n\n")
}

# ---- Heatmap: curated families (optionally significant rows only) ----
plot_curated <- function(se, motif_ids, width = 1.8, sig_only = FALSE, show_motif_GC = FALSE) {
  se_f <- se[motif_ids, ]
  if (sig_only) se_f <- filter_sig_rows(se_f)
  if (nrow(se_f) == 0) {
    cat("No curated motif reaches padj < 0.05.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  plotMotifHeatmaps(se_f, which.plots = c("log2enr", "negLog10Padj"),
                    width = width, cluster = FALSE, maxEnr = 2, maxSig = 10,
                    show_seqlogo = TRUE, width.seqlogo = 1.2,
                    show_motif_GC = show_motif_GC)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Motif collection

```{r results='asis'}
pwms     <- readRDS(params$pwm_rds)
pwm_name <- map_chr(as.list(pwms), name)
pwm_fam  <- annotate_family(pwm_name)

# ---- Curated motif IDs in family order (shared by all monaLisa results) ----
fam_ord <- tibble(motif_id = names(pwms), family = pwm_fam) |>
  filter(!is.na(family)) |>
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = names(fam_patterns))) |>
  arrange(family)

pwms_contingency <- tibble(motif = pwm_name, family = pwm_fam) |>
  filter(!is.na(family)) |>
  arrange(family, motif) |>
  group_by(family) |>
  summarise(n = n(), motifs = paste(motif, collapse = ", "))

show_dt(pwms_contingency)
```

# Up / Down vs unchanged across all three contrasts

```{r}
# ---- DA class per contrast, NS capped ----
classify_da <- function(tbl, fdr, max_ns) {
  tbl |>
    mutate(class = case_when(FDR < fdr & logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
                             FDR < fdr & logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
                             TRUE                  ~ "NS")) |>
    group_by(class) |>
    group_modify(\(d, k) if (k$class == "NS" && nrow(d) > max_ns)
                           slice_sample(d, n = max_ns) else d) |>
    ungroup()
}

run_class_enr <- function(tbl, pwm_sub, fa, keep_chr, width, min_score, bpp) {
  gr   <- make_regions(tbl, keep_chr, width = width)
  bins <- droplevels(factor(gr$class, levels = c("Down", "NS", "Up")))
  calcBinnedMotifEnrR(seqs = get_seqs(gr, fa), bins = bins, pwmL = pwm_sub,
                      background = "otherBins", min.score = min_score,
                      BPPARAM = bpp)
}

cls_file <- file.path(out_rds, "monalisa_class_all_contrasts.rds")

if (!params$rerun && file.exists(cls_file)) {
  cls_se <- readRDS(cls_file)
} else {
  pwm_sub <- pwms[!is.na(pwm_fam)]
  cls_se  <- map(edger_obj$res, \(tbl) {
    classify_da(tbl, params$fdr, params$max_bin0) |>
      run_class_enr(pwm_sub, fa, keep_chr, params$seq_width, params$min_score, bpp)
  })
  saveRDS(cls_se, cls_file)
}

cls_long <- map(cls_se, tidy_enr) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "contrast") |>
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = names(edger_obj$res)),
         family   = factor(family, levels = names(fam_patterns))) |>
  arrange(desc(negLog10Padj))

write_csv(cls_long, file.path(out_tab, "monalisa_class_all_contrasts.csv"))
```
